title: Matched 12-parameter HOM joint-prior SBC and two-sided robust sensor holdout

prior_sbc.physics: single- and three-boson Fock splitter, 5 source events, threshold detectors, electronic background, Gaussian random walk and PNR report mixing
prior_sbc.important: Formal SBC for this specifically matched PRIOR-generative restricted model; no fixed-truth or real instrument guarantee.

robust_heldout.models: Gaussian MLE vs Student-t location/scale MLE with fixed df=4
robust_heldout.important: Separate zero-phase sensor reference submodel; NOT a Student-t HOM state-space posterior or full SBC.

limitations: Hyperparameters have a finite 27-point discrete prior, not the fully continuous hyperprior of v1.03
Source PNR classifier standards and matched electronics standards assume externally known conditions
Only optical 0-3 photon and ideal triplet indistinguishable versus fully distinguishable extremes
Approximate finite-particle/grid posterior; negative SBC p-test is not proof of error-free inference
No independent historical individual photon identity observable
